title: vaccinium oblongifolium
intro: Vaccinium oblongifolium, commonly known as the Blue Ridge Currant, is a plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium oblongifolium may include supporting cardiovascular health, modulating immune function, and exhibiting neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
